name.fr-FR: Dieu, son existence et sa nature : solution thomiste des antinomies agnostiques
name.en-US: God: His Existence and His Nature (French original)
name.pt-BR: Deus, sua existência e sua natureza: solução tomista das antinomias agnósticas

description.fr-FR: Théodicée thomiste en deux parties : l’existence de Dieu (enseignement de l’Église, démonstrabilité, preuves) et sa nature et ses attributs (constitutif formel de la divinité, attributs, antinomies). Première édition, Beauchesne, 1914, avec la note sur la valeur des principes.
description.en-US: Thomistic natural theology in two parts: the existence of God (the Church’s teaching, demonstrability, the proofs) and His nature and attributes (the formal constitutive of the Godhead, the attributes, the antinomies). First edition, Beauchesne, 1914. The English translation, made from the fifth edition, is its own book.
description.pt-BR: Teodiceia tomista em duas partes: a existência de Deus (ensinamento da Igreja, demonstrabilidade, provas) e sua natureza e atributos (constitutivo formal, atributos, antinomias). Primeira edição, Beauchesne, 1914.

sources.edition: Dieu, son existence et sa nature, Beauchesne, 1914 (Google scan on archive.org, OCR text); part and chapter divisions only, the book’s numbered sections are not split
